description.value: Cilantro & Jalapeño is a multi-award-winning authentic Mexican takeout restaurant inside Lonsdale Quay Market on North Vancouver's waterfront, voted Best Mexican Restaurant on the North Shore six consecutive years (2010–2015). The kitchen produces scratch-made tacos, tamales, enchiladas, burritos, and house sauces using traditional recipes, alongside a retail selection of hard-to-find Latin American specialty ingredients. The market location sits steps from the SeaBus terminal, making it a convenient refuelling stop for cyclists travelling between downtown Vancouver and the North Shore.
